chunks: And from him (Al-Hassan ibn Mahbub) from Mu'ammara ibn Khallad who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Does a man prefer some of his wives over others? He said: 'No, and there is no objection to it among the slave-women.'
ai.seo_question: Does a husband have to treat all his wives equally according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the juristic distinction between wives and slave-women regarding concubinage, ruling that while preference among wives is discouraged to maintain equity, it is permissible among slave-women. This reflects the classical Shia legal view that the strict requirement of equal treatment (*‘adl*) applies more rigorously to free wives due to their higher social and marital status, whereas concubines do not carry the same obligation of equal distribution of time or resources.
